verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT auth and regional endpoints. However, hands-on inspection found the API reference is rendered from bundled JS with static code samples, and no OpenAPI artifact is published: kling.ai/openapi.json serves the application shell. The llms.txt file is a prose product summary, not a machine-readable API spec, so no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
